result.title: SpatialDuet: Bayesian task routing between a metric expert and a geometry expert for spatial intelligence
result.summary: Embodied assistants and wearable devices need 3D spatial reasoning, and their limited hardware restricts them to small vision-language models (VLMs). Small spatial VLMs acquire different abilities from their training: a model trained on large spatial question sets estimates object and room sizes well, whereas a model with a 3D geometry encoder is better at relative directions and absolute distances. Instead of training a single model for all spatial tasks, as published methods do, we build one system that uses each frozen model for the tasks it handles best. We propose SpatialDuet, which pairs a metric expert with a geometry expert under a Bayesian task router. The metric expert is a data-driven spatial VLM run with three training-free modules: training-aligned sampling, metric-aware minimum Bayes risk decoding and per-type metric calibration. The geometry expert is a VLM with a 3D geometry encoder. For each question type, the router estimates from labelled development questions how likely each expert is to be better, and pools their answers with that probability as weight, in log space for numeric answers and over the option distributions for multiple-choice answers. Extensive experiments on four spatial benchmarks covering video and single images validate SpatialDuet; it outperforms the best published small VLMs by 3.17% on VSI-Bench and, excluding a model trained on CV-Bench-style data, by 1.44% on CV-Bench, without training any model weight.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SpatialDuet，用贝叶斯任务路由连接一个冻结的度量型空间 VLM（含免训练采样、度量感知 MBR 解码与按题型校准）和一个带 3D 几何编码器的 VLM，按题型估计各专家更优的概率并在输出层融合答案，在四个空间基准上验证且不训练权重。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按题型估计专家可靠度并加权汇合输出的做法，可供核查 LVR 中多假设、视觉证据来源选择与贡献分配的设计，但只作用于答案层，未涉及内部 latent 状态。
